G0976.def:
**βίβλος**, -ου, ἡ (variant form of βύβλος, the Egyptian _papyrus_, paper made from its fibrous coat),
[in LXX for סֶפֶר, the form βύβ- being sometimes used ;]
**a book, a roll**, used much less frequently than βιβλίον, and with a "connotation of sacredness and veneration" (MM, _Exp._, x), [[Mat.1.1|Mat.1:1]] [[Mrk.12.26|Mrk.12:26]], [[Luk.3.4; 20.42|Luk.3:4 20:42]] [[Act.1.20; 7.42; 19.19|Act.1:20 7:42 19:19]]; β. τ. ζωῆς, [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]], [[Rev.3.5; 20.15|Rev.3:5 20:15]].†
(AS)

G0935.def:
**βασιλεύς**, -έως, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for מֶלֶךְ ;]
**a king**: [[Mat.1.6; 2.1|Mat.1:6 2:1]]; used by courtesy of Herod the Tetrarch, [[Mat.14.9|Mat.14:9]] of the Roman Emperor, as frequently in κοινή (Deiss., _LAE_, p. 367), [[1Pe.2.13, 17|1Pe.2:13, 17]]; of the Christ, in the phrase ὁ β. τ. Ἰουδαίων, [[Mat.2.2|Mat.2:2]], al.; τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, [[Mrk.15.32|Mrk.15:32]], [[Jhn.1.50; 12.13|Jhn.1:50 12:13]]; of God, [[Mat.5.35|Mat.5:35]], [[1Ti.1.17|1Ti.1:17]], [[Rev.15.3|Rev.15:3]]; β. βασιλέων, [[Rev.17.14; 19.16|Rev.17:14 19:16]]; β. τ. βασιλευόντων, [[1Ti.6.15|1Ti.6:15]] (on the associations of the word to Jewish Hellenists, see _Cl. Rev._, i, 7).†
(AS)

G0965.def:
**Βηθλέεμ**, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בֵּית לֶחֶם, _house of bread_),
**Bethlehem**, a town 6 m. S. of Jerusalem: [[Mat.2.1, 5, 6, 8, 16|Mat.2:1, 5 6, 8, 16]], [[Luk.2.4, 15|Luk.2:4, 15]] [[Jhn.7.42|Jhn.7:42]].†
(AS)

G0936.def:
**βασιλεύω**, (βασιλεύς),
[in LXX for מלךְ, its parts and derivatives, exc. [[2Ki.15.5|4Ki.15:5]] (ישׁב) ;]
**to be king, to reign, rule**: [[1Ti.6.15|1Ti.6:15]] with genitive (cl.), [[Mat.2.22|Mat.2:22]] before ἐπί, with accusative (= Heb. מלךְ על; Bl., §36, 8), [[Luk.1.33; 19.14, 27|Luk.1:33 19:14, 27]] [[Rom.5.14|Rom.5:14]]; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς, **on earth**, [[Rev.5.10|Rev.5:10]] of God, [[Rev.11.15, 17; 19.6|Rev.11:15, 17 19:6]]; of Christ, [[Luk.1.33|Luk.1:33]], [[1Co.15.25|1Co.15:25]], [[Rev.11.15|Rev.11:15]]; of Christians, [[Rev.5.10; 20.4|Rev.5:10 20:4]] (constative aor., M, _Pr._, 130), ib. 6 22:5. Metaphorical, Christians, [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]], [[1Co.4.8|1Co.4:8]] θάνατος, [[Rom.5.14, 17|Rom.5:14, 17]]; ἁμαρτία, [[Rom.5.21; 6.12|Rom.5:21 6:12]]. Ingressive aor. (M, _Pr._, 109), **to begin to reign**: [[1Co.4.8|1Co.4:8]], [[Rev.11.17; 19.6|Rev.11:17 19:6]] (Cremer, 137).†
(AS)

G0932.def:
**βασιλεία**, -ας, ἡ
(βασιλεύω), [in LXX chiefly for מַמְלָכָה ,מַלְכוּת ;]
1. prop. abstract, **sovereignty, royal power, dominion**: [[Luk.1.33; 22.29|Luk.1:33 22:29]], [[Jhn.18.36|Jhn.18:36]], [[Act.1.6|Act.1:6]], [[Heb.1.8|Heb.1:8]], [[1Co.15.24|1Co.15:24]]; λαβεῖν β., [[Luk.19.12, 15|Luk.19:12, 15]] [[Rev.17.12|Rev.17:12]]; δοῦναι τὴν, ib. 17; ἔχειν β., ib. 18; ἔρχεσθαι ἐν τ. (εἰς τὴν) β., [[Mat.16.28|Mat.16:28]], [[Luk.23.42|Luk.23:42]]; β. τ. θεοῦ, [[Rev.12.10|Rev.12:10]]
2. By meton., concrete (MM, _Exp._, x),
(a) **a kingdom**, the territory or people over whom the king rules ([[Est.5.3|Est.5:3]], al.): [[Mat.4.8; 12.25, 26; 24.7|Mat.4:8 12:25, 26 24:7]], [[Mrk.3.24; 6.23|Mrk.3:24 6:23]], [[Luk.4.5|Luk.4:5]], [[Heb.11.33|Heb.11:33]], al.;
(b) **the royal majesty** (cf. our phrase _His Majesty_), **the king** himself (τ. σπέρμα τῆς β., [[2Ki.11.1|4Ki.11:1]]).
3. In LXX ([[Wis.6.5|Wis.6:5]], [[Tob.13.1|Tob.13:1]], al.), Targ. and NT, of the Messianic rule and kingdom, ἡ β. τ. θεοῦ, τ. οὐρανῶν (Heb. מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם, Aram. מַלְכוּתָא דִשׁמַיָּא; see Dalman, _Words_, 91-147; Cremer, 132, 658), **the kingdom of God** (on the equivalence of the two phrases, see Dalman, _op. cit._, 93, 218f.); τ. θεοῦ, [[Mat.6.33; 12.28|Mat.6:33 12:28]], al.; τ. οὐρανῶν, [[Mat.3.2; 4.17|Mat.3:2 4:17]], al.; τ. Χριστοῦ (מַלִכוּת דִמְשִׁיחא, Targ. Jon. on [[Isa.53.10|Isa.53:10]]), [[Eph.5.5|Eph.5:5]]; τ. κυρίου, [[2Pe.1.11|2Pe.1:11]], [[Rev.11.15|Rev.11:15]]; τ. Δαυείδ, [[Mrk.11.10|Mrk.11:10]] absol., ἡ β., [[Mat.4.23|Mat.4:23]], [[Jas.2.5|Jas.2:5]], al. The kingdom is regarded as present: [[Mat.11.12|Mat.11:12]], [[Luk.17.21|Luk.17:21]], [[Rom.14.17|Rom.14:17]], al.; as that which is to be consummated in the future, [[Mat.6.10|Mat.6:10]], [[Mrk.9.1|Mrk.9:1]], [[Jhn.3.5|Jhn.3:5]], [[2Pe.1.11|2Pe.1:11]], al. Noteworthy phrases are: ζητεῖν τὴν β., [[Mat.6.33|Mat.6:33]] δέχεσθαι, [[Mrk.10.15|Mrk.10:15]] κλρονομεῖν, [[Mat.25.34|Mat.25:34]] διδόναι, [[Luk.12.32|Lk 12:32]]; παραλαμβάνειν, [[Heb.12.28|Heb.12:28]] αὐτῶν (τοιούτων) εστὶν ἡ β., [[Mat.5.3, 10; 19.14|Mat.5:3, 10 19:14]], [[Mrk.10.14|Mrk.10:14]], [[Luk.18.16|Luk.18:16]]; διὰ τὴν β., [[Mat.19.12|Mat.19:12]] ἕνεκεν τῆς β., [[Luk.18.29|Luk.18:29]] εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, κηρύσσειν, διαγγέλλειν τὴν β., [[Luk.4.43; 9.2, 60|Luk.4:43 9:2, 60]]; ἤγγικεν ἡ β., [[Mat.3.2|Mat.3:2]], [[Mrk.1.15|Mrk.1:15]]; κλεῖς τῆς β., [[Mat.16.10|Mat.16:10]] κλείειν τὴν β., [[Mat.23.14|Mat.23:14]] υἱοὶ τῆς β., [[Mat.8.12; 13.38|Mat.8:12 13:38]] (cf. Cremer, 132, 658).
(AS)

G0994.def:
**βοάω**, -ῶ
(βοή), [in LXX chiefly for זעק, צעק, קרא ;]
1. absol., **to cry, call out**: [[Mat.3.3; 27.46|Mat.3:3, 27:46]], [[Mrk.1.3; 15.34|Mrk.1:3 15:34]], [[Luk.3.4; 9.38; 18.38|Luk.3:4 9:38 18:38]], [[Jhn.1.23|Jhn.1:23]], [[Act.8.7; 17.6; 25.24|Act.8:7 17:6 25:24]], [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]].
2. C. dative, **to call on** for help (Heb. זעק על, [[Hos.7.14|Hos.7:14]], al.), [[Luk.18.7|Luk.18:7]].†
_SYN._: καλέω, _to call, invite, summon_; κράζω, _to cry_, harshly or inarticulately, as animals; κραυγάζω, intensive of κράζω. βοάω expresses emotion, whether joy, fear, etc. (AS)

G0906.def:
**βάλλω**,
[in LXX for נפל, שׂום, ידד, etc. ;]
prop., of a weapon or missile; then generally, of things and persons, lit. and metaphorically, **to throw, cast, put, place**: with accusative, before εἰς, [[Mat.4.18|Mat.4:18]], and frequently ἐπί, [[Mat.10.34|Mat.10:34]] κάτω, [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]] ἔξω, [[Mat.5.13|Mat.5:13]] ἀπό, [[Mat.5.29|Mat.5:29]] ἐκ, [[Mrk.12.44|Mrk.12:44]] δρέπανον, [[Rev.14.19|Rev.14:19]] μάχαιραν, [[Mat.10.34|Mat.10:34]] κλῆρον, [[Mat.27.35|Mat.27:35]] of fluids, **to pour**: [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]], [[Jhn.13.5|Jhn.13:5]]; pass., **to be laid, to lie ill**: [[Mat.9.2|Mat.9:2]] ἐβλήθη (timeless aor., M, _Pr._, 134), [[Jhn.15.6|Jhn.15:6]] intrans., **to rush** (Bl., §53, 1): [[Act.27.14|Act.27:14]] Metaphorical, β. εἰς τ. καρδίαν, [[Jhn.13.2|Jhn.13:2]] (cf. usage in π., without idea of violence; also of liquids; MM, _Exp._, x; see also Cremer, 120, 657; cf. ἀμφι-, ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐμ-, παρ-εμ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, συμ-, ὑπερ-, ὑπο-βάλλω).
(AS)

G0931.def:
**βάσανος**, -ου, ὁ (of Oriental origin),
[in LXX chiefly for כְּלִמָּה ,אָשָׁם, and frequently in 4Mac ;]
1. prop., **touchstone**, a dark stone used in testing metals.
2. **examination by torture**.
3. **torment, torture**: [[Mat.4.24|Mat.4:24]], [[Luk.15.23, 28|Luk.15:23, 28]].
† (AS)

G0928.def:
**βασανίζω**
(βάσανος), [in LXX: [[1Ki.5.3|1Ki.5:3]], [[Sir.4.17|Sir.4:17]], and frequently in Wi, II, 4Mac ;]
1. prop., **to rub on the touchstone, put to the test**.
2. **to examine by torture,** hence, generally, **to torture, torment, distress**: [[Mat.8.6, 29; 14.24|Mat.8:6, 29 14:24]], [[Mrk.5.7; 6.48|Mrk.5:7 6:48]], [[Luk.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[2Pe.2.8|2Pe.2:8]], [[Rev.9.5; 11.10; 12.2; 14.10; 20.10|Rev.9:5 11:10 12:2 14:10 20:10]].
† (AS)

G0987.def:
**βλασφημέω**, -ῶ
(βλάσφημος), [in LXX: [[2Ki.19.4|4Ki.19:4]] (יכח hi.) ib. 6, 22 (גּדף pi.), [[Isa.52.5|Isa.52:5]] (נאץ hith.), Dan LXX 3:29 (96) (אמר שׁלח), [[Tob.1.18|Tob.1:18]], Da TH Bel 9, 2Ma.2 * ;]
1. **to speak lightly or profanely of sacred things** (in cl., opp. of εὐφημέω), esp. **to speak impiously of God, to blaspheme, speak blasphemously**: absol., [[Mat.9.3; 26.65|Mat.9:3 26:65]], [[Mrk.2.7|Mrk.2:7]], [[Jhn.10.36|Jhn.10:36]], [[Act.26.11|Act.26:11]], [[1Ti.1.20|1Ti.1:20]], [[2Pe.2.12|2Pe.2:12]]; τ. θεόν, [[Act.19.37|Act.19:37]], [[Rev.16.11, 21|Rev.16:11, 21]]; τὸ ὄνομα τ. θεοῦ, [[Rev.13.6; 16.9|Rev.13:6 16:9]]; δόξας, [[Jude.3|Ju 3]], [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]]; εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, [[Mrk.3.29|Mrk.3:29]], [[Luk.12.10|Luk.12:10]].
2. **to revile, rail at, slander**: absol., [[Luk.22.65|Luk.22:65]], [[Act.13.45; 18.6|Act.13:45 18:6]], [[1Pe.4.4|1Pe.4:4]]; with accusative, [[Mat.27.39|Mat.27:39]], [[Mrk.3.28; 15.29|Mrk.3:28 15:29]], [[Luk.23.39|Luk.23:39]], [[Tit.3.2|Tit.3:2]], [[Jas.2.7|Jas.2:7]], [[Jude.10|Ju 10]]. Pass.: [[Rom.2.24; 3.8; 14.16|Rom.2:24 3:8 14:16]], [[1Co.10.30|1Co.10:30]], [[1Ti.6.1|1Ti.6:1]], [[Tit.2.5|Tit.2:5]], [[2Pe.2.2|2Pe.2:2]] (Cremer, 570).
† (AS)

G0918.def:
**Βαρθολομαῖος**, -ου, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־תָּלְמַי, **son of Tolmai**),
**Bartholomew**, **the Apostle **(see: Ναθαναήλ): [[Mat.10.3|Mat.10:3]], [[Mrk.3.18|Mrk.3:18]], [[Luk.6.14|Luk.6:14]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]].†
(AS)

G0954.def:
**Βεελζεβούλ** (WH, _App._, 159, Rec., βεελζεβούλ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, _lord_, and the Talmudic זִבּוּל, from זֶבֶל, _dung_ (Dalman, _Gr._, 137.n), or perh. זִבֻל, **habitation**, but, see _DB_, iv, 409f.; _DCG_, i, 181). The AV, RV, **Beelzebub**, comes through Vg. from [[2Ki.1.2|4Ki.1:2]], בַּעַל זִבוּב, **lord of flies** (LXX, βάαλ μυῖα, Sm., βεελζεβούβ),
**Beelzebul, Beelzebub**, a name of Satan: [[Mat.10.25; 12.24, 27|Mat.10:25 12:24, 27]] [[Mrk.3.22|Mrk.3:22]], [[Luk.11.15, 18, 19|Luk.11:15, 18 19]].†
(AS)

G0971.def:
**βιάζω** (βία), and depon. -ομαι,
[in LXX for פּרץ, פּצר, etc. ;]
**to force, constrain**, rare in active (poet, and late prose), but found in cl. in pass., and so perh. βιάζεται, **suffereth violence**, [[Mat.11.12|Mat.11:12]], EV (but see infr.), whether
(a) in good sense, of disciples (Thayer, al.), or
(b) in bad sense, of the enemies of the kingdom (Meyer, in l.; Dalman, _Words_, 139ff.; Cremer, 141ff.). Mid., **advanceth violently**, Mt, l.with (Deiss., _BS_., 258; Banks, see ref. in DCG, ii, 803f.); before εἰς, **to press violently**, or **force one's way into**, [[Luk.16.16|Luk.16:16]] (see _ICC_, in l., and in Mt, l.with; cf. παραβιάζομαι and see MM, see word).
† (AS)

G0973.def:
**βιαστής**, -οῦ, ὁ (βιάζω), late form of βιατάς;
1. **strong, forceful**.
2. **violent** (Philo): [[Mat.11.12|Mat.11:12]] (see: βιάζω).
† (AS)

G0966.def:
**Βηθσαιδά** (Rec. -σαϊδά), and -δάν (Mt, Mk, ll. with), ἡ, indecl. (Syr., _house of fish_),
**Bethsaida**, a town on NE. shore of the Sea of Galilee: [[Luk.9.10|Luk.9:10]] It is generally supposed that a second B. on the W. shore is referred to in [[Mat.11.21|Mat.11:21]], [[Mrk.6.45; 8.22|Mrk.6:45 8:22]], [[Luk.10.13|Luk.10:13]], [[Jhn.1.45; 12.21|Jhn.1:45 12:21]] (_DB_, i, 282f.; but see Swete on [[Mrk.6.45|Mrk.6:45]]).
2. 2. ** Βηθζαθά**, ἡ, indecl. (perh. Aram. בֵּית זַיְתָה, _house of olives_) [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]].†
(AS)

G0953.def:
**βεβηλόω**, -ῶ
(βέβηλος), [in LXX chiefly for חלל ;]
**to profane**: τ. σάββατον, [[Mat.12.5|Mat.12:5]] τ. ἱερόν, [[Act.24.6|Act.24:6]] (Cremer, 141).†
_SYN._: κοινόω, which see (AS)

G0999.def:
**βόθυνος**, -ου, ὁ (= βόθρος, more frequently in cl.),
[in LXX chiefly for פַּחַת ;]
**a pit**: [[Mat.12.11; 15.14|Mat.12:11 15:14]], [[Luk.6.39|Luk.6:39]] (cf. _DB_, iii, 885; _DCG_, ii, 367).†
(AS)

G0938.def:
**βασίλισσα**, -ης, ἡ (in Attic, βασιλεία, βασιλίς),
[in LXX chiefly for מַלְכָּה ;]
**a queen**: [[Mat.12.42|Mat.12:42]], [[Luk.11.31|Luk.11:31]], [[Act.8.27|Act.8:27]], [[Rev.18.7|Rev.18:7]].†
(AS)

G0917.def:
**βαρέως**, _adv._
(βαρύς), [in LXX: β. φέρειν, [[Gen.31.35|Gen.31:35]] (חרה בעיני); β. ἀκούειν, [[Isa.6.10|Isa.6:10]] (כּבד hi.)* ;]
**heavily, with difficulty**: [[Mat.13.15|Mat.13:15]], [[Act.28.27|Act.28:27]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G0985.def:
**βλαστάνω**,
[in LXX for צמח, etc. ;]
1. **to sprout**: [[Mat.13.26|Mat.13:26]], [[Mrk.4.27|Mrk.4:27]], [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]].
2. In late Gk., causal, **to make to grow, produce**: with accusative, [[Jas.5.18|Jas.5:18]]
† (AS)

G0997.def:
**βοηθέω**, -ῶ
(βοή + θέω, _to run_), [in LXX chiefly for עזר ;]
**to come to aid, to help, succour**: absol., [[Act.21.28|Act.21:28]] with dative, [[Mat.15.25|Mat.15:25]], [[Mrk.9.22, 24|Mrk.9:22, 24]] [[Act.16.9|Act.16:9]], [[2Co.6.2|2Co.6:2]]" (LXX), [[Heb.2.18|Heb.2:18]], [[Rev.12.16|Rev.12:16]].†
(AS)

G0920.def:
**Βαριωνᾶς**, **Βαριωνᾶ**, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־יוֹנָה, **son of Jonah**),
**Bar-Jonah**, a surname of Peter: [[Mat.16.17|Mat.16:17]]†
(AS)

G0930.def:
**βασανιστής**, -οῦ, ὁ (βασανίζω),
prop., **a torturer**; used of a gaoler, [[Mat.18.34|Mat.18:34]]†
(AS)

G0975.def:
**βιβλίον**, -ου, τό (diminutive of βίβλος, which see),
[in LXX also in the alternat. form βυβ-, chiefly for סֶפֶר and the most frequently of the cognate forms ;]
1. **a paper, letter, written document**: β. ἀποστασίου, **bill of divorce**, [[Mat.19.7|Mat.19:7]], [[Mrk.10.4|Mrk.10:4]].
2. **a book, a roll**: [[Luk.4.17, 20|Luk.4:17, 20]] [[Jhn.20.30; 21.25|Jhn.20:30 21:25]], [[Gal.3.10|Gal.3:10]], [[2Ti.4.13|2Ti.4:13]], [[Heb.9.19; 10.7|Heb.9:19 10:7]], [[Rev.1.11; 5.1-9; 6.14; 10.8; 20.12; 22.7-19|Rev.1:11 5:1-9 6:14 10:8 20:12 22:7-19]]; β. τ. ζωῆς, [[Rev.13.8; 17.8; 20.12; 21.27|Rev.13:8 17:8 20:12 21:27]].
† (AS)

G0967.def:
**Βηθφαγή** (L, -γῆ), ἡ, indecl. (Aram. בֵּית־פַּגֵּי, _house of unripe figs_; Dalman, _Gr._, 191),
**Bethphage**: [[Mat.21.1|Mat.21:1]], [[Mrk.11.1|Mrk.11:1]], [[Luk.19.29|Luk.19:29]].†
(AS)

G0963.def:
**Βηθανία**, -ας (also -ιά, indecl., [[Luk.19.29|Luk.19:29]] and in B*, [[Mrk.11.1|Mrk.11:1]]), ἡ, (Heb. בֵּית עֲנִיָּה, _house of affliction_, accusative to Jerome, or perh., _house of dates_, cf. _Bethphage_),
**Bethany**;
1. **a village fifteen furlongs from Jerusalem, the modern El Azerîyeh**: [[Mat.21.17; 26.6|Mat.21:17 26:6]], [[Mrk.8.22|Mrk.8:22]] (WH, mg.) 11:1, 11, 12 14:3 [[Luk.19.29; 24.50|Luk.19:29 24:50]], [[Jhn.11.1, 18; 12.1|Jhn.11:1, 18 12:1]].
2. A place on E. bank of Jordan: [[Jhn.1.28|Jhn.1:28]] (R, mg., Βηθαβαρά, which see).
† (AS)

G0926.def:
**βαρύς**, -εῖα, ύ,
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבֵד ;]
**heavy**: [[Mat.23.4|Mat.23:4]] Metaphorical, **burdensome**: ἐντολή, [[1Jn.5.3|1Jn.5:3]] **severe** (perh. **impressive**): ἐπιστολή, [[2Co.10.10|2Co.10:10]] **weighty**: τὰ βαρύτερα τ. νόμου, [[Mat.23.23|Mat.23:23]] αἰτιώματα, [[Act.25.7|Act.25:7]] **violent, cruel** (EV, **grievous**): λύκος, [[Act.20.29|Act.20:29]]†
(AS)

G0946.def:
**βδέλυγμα**, -τος, τό
(βδελύσσω), [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶץ ,תּוֹעֵבָה ;]
**an abomination, a detestable thing**: [[Luk.16.15|Luk.16:15]], [[Rev.17.4, 5; 21.27|Rev.17:4, 5 21:27]]; τὸ β. τ. ἐρημώσεως (Dan LXX 12:11, cf . [[1Ma.1.54|1Ma.1:54]] _DB_, i, 12f.; _DCG_, i, 6f.), [[Mrk.13.14|Mrk.13:14]], [[Mat.24.15|Mat.24:15]] (Cremer, 138).†
(AS)

G0927.def:
**βαρύτιμος**, -ον
(βαρύς, τιμή),
**of great value, very costly**: [[Mat.26.7|Mat.26:7]] (T, πολυτίμου) .†
(AS)

G0916.def:
**βαρέω**, -ῶ (later form of βαρύνω, which see),
[in LXX: [[Exo.7.14|Exo.7:14]] (כָּבֵד), [[2Ma.13.9|2Ma.13:9]] * ;]
**to depress, weigh down**. In NT, in pass. only: [[Mat.26.43|Mat.26:43]], [[Luk.9.32; 21.34|Luk.9:32 21:34]], [[2Co.1.8; 5.4|2Co.1:8 5:4]], [[1Ti.5.16|1Ti.5:16]].†
(AS)

G0912.def:
**Βαραββᾶς**, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־אַבָּא, lit., **son of a father**, i.e. accusative to Jerome, filius magistri),
**Barabbas**: [[Mat.27.16, 17, 20, 21, 26|Mat.27:16, 17 20, 21, 26]], [[Mrk.15.7, 11, 15|Mrk.15:7, 11 15]], [[Luk.23.18|Luk.23:18]], [[Jhn.18.40|Jhn.18:40]]. (In [[Mat.27.16|Mat.27:16]], some MSS. read Ἰησοῦν Β.; see WH, App., 19f.).†
(AS)

G0968.def:
**βῆμα**, -τος, τό
(βαίνω), [in LXX: [[Deu.2.5|Deu.2:5]] (מִדְרָךְ), [[Neh.8.4|Neh.8:4]] (מִגְדָּל), I [[Est.9.42|Est.9:42]], [[Sir.19.30; 45.9|Sir.19:30 45:9]], [[2Ma.13.26|2Ma.13:26]] * ;]
1. **a step, stride, pace**: [[Act.7.5|Act.7:5]]
2. **a raised place, a platform** reached by steps, originally that in the Pnyx at Athens from which orations were made; frequently of the **tribune** or **tribunal** of a Roman magistrate or ruler: [[Mat.27.19|Mat.27:19]], [[Jhn.19.13|Jhn.19:13]], [[Act.12.21; 18.12, 16, 17; 25.6, 10, 17|Act.12:21, 18:12, 16, 17 25:6, 10, 17]]; β. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[Rom.14.10|Rom.14:10]] τ. Χριστοῦ, [[2Co.5.10|2Co.5:10]]
† (AS)

G0993.def:
**Βοανηργές**, indecl. (on the derivation, see Dalman, _Gr._, 144; _Words_, 42; Swete, _Mk._, l.with; _DCG_, i, 216),
**Boanerges**: [[Mrk.3.17|Mrk.3:17]]†
(AS)

G0909.def:
**βαπτισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ (βαπτίζω), prop., the act of which βάπτισμα is the result;
1. **a dipping, washing, lustration**: [[Mrk.7.4|Mrk.7:4]] of Jewish ceremonial. [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]] in [[Heb.6.2|Heb.6:2]], βαπτισμῶν διδαχήν (-ῆς), "the pl. and the peculiar form seem to be used to include Christian baptism with other lustral rites" (Westc, in l.).
2. **baptism**: FlJ, Ant., 18, 5, 2 (of John's baptism), and some Fathers (see Soph., see word). Not so in NT, unless ἐν τ. βαπτισμῷ, _in the act of baptism_, [[Col.2.12|Col.2:12]], be read with Tr. (Rec., WH, R, -ματι).
† (AS)

G0924.def:
**Βαρτίμαιος**, -ου, ὁ (-μαῖος, T; perh. Aram. בַּר־טִמְאַי, see _DB_, iv, p. 762),
**Bartimæus**: [[Mrk.10.46|Mrk.10:46]]†
(AS)

G0942.def:
**βάτος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX (always masc, as in Attic): [[Exo.3.2-4|Exo.3:2-4]], [[Deu.33.16|Deu.33:16]] (סְנֶה), [[Job.31.40|Job.31:40]] (בָּאְשָׁה)* ;]
**a bramble-bush**: [[Luk.6.44|Luk.6:44]], [[Act.7.30, 35|Act.7:30, 35]]; ἐπὶ τοῦ (τῆς) β., **in the place concerning the bush**: [[Mrk.12.26|Mrk.12:26]], [[Luk.20.37|Luk.20:37]].†
(AS)

G0979.def:
**βίος**, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for יָמִים ;]
1. **period** or **course of life, life**: [[Luk.8.14|Luk.8:14]], [[1Ti.2.2|1Ti.2:2]], [[2Ti.2.4|2Ti.2:4]], [[1Jn.2.16|1Jn.2:16]].
2. **living, livelihood, means** (in [[Pro.31.14|Pro.31:14]] for לֶחֶם; see _DCG_, ii, 39a): [[Mrk.12.44|Mrk.12:44]], [[Luk.8.43; 15.12, 30; 21.4|Luk.8:43 15:12, 30 21:4]], [[1Jn.3.17|1Jn.3:17]].†
_SYN._: ζωή, is life _intensive_, "vita quâ, vivimus," the vital principle; βίος, life _extensive_, "vita quam vivimus," (1) the period of life, (2) the means by which it is sustained. Hence, in cl., ζ., being confined to the physical life common to men and animals, is the inferior word (cf. _zoology, biography_). In NT, ζωή is elevated into the ethical and spiritual sphere (cf. Tr., _Syn._, §xxvii). (AS)

G0900.def:
**βαθύνω**
(βαθύς), [in LXX for עמד: Psa.91 (92):5, Jer.29 (49):8 30(49)30 * ;]
**to deepen**: [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]]†
(AS)

G0933.def:
**βασίλειον**, -ου, τό
(βασίλειος, which see), [in LXX for הֵיכָל ( [[Nam.2.6|Nam.2:6]], [[Dan.6.18|Dan.6:18]]*), מַמְלָכָה ( [[3Ki.3.1 14:8|3Ki.3:1 14:8]], [[2Ki.15.19|4Ki.15:19]]*), etc. ;]
1. a **capital city**.
2. Freq. in pl., τὰ β., **a palace**: [[Luk.7.25|Luk.7:25]]
† (AS)

G0943.def:
**βάτος**, -ου, ὁ (Heb. בַּת),
[in LXX (also βαίθ, βάδος): II [[Est.7.22|Est.7:22]] * ;]
**bath**, a Jewish liquid measure, = μετρητής (which see), or about 8 3/4 gals.: [[Luk.16.6|Luk.16:6]]†
(AS)

G0911.def:
**βάπτω**,
[in LXX chiefly for טבל ;]
(a) **to dip**: [[Luk.16.24|Luk.16:24]], [[Jhn.13.26|Jhn.13:26]] (ἐμβ-, L);
(b) **to dip in dye, to dye**: [[Rev.19.13|Rev.19:13]] (Rec.; ῥεραντισμένον, WH; περιρεραμμένον, T; ῥεραμμένον, Swete, in l., which see).
† (AS)

G0901.def:
**βαθύς** (genitive -έως, vernac., Lk, l.with; Bl., §8, 5), -εῖα, -ύ,
[in LXX chiefly for עמק ;]
**deep**; [[Jhn.4.11|Jhn.4:11]] metaphorically, ὄρθρου βαθέως (see supr.), **early dawn**, [[Luk.24.1|Luk.24:1]] ὕπνος, [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]] τὰ β. τοῦ Σατανᾶ, [[Rev.2.24|Rev.2:24]]†
(AS)

G0937.def:
**βασιλικός**, -ή, -όν (βασιλεύς),
[in LXX for מֶלֶךְ and its cognates ;]
**royal, belonging to a king**: χώρα, [[Act.12.20|Act 12:20]] ἐσθής, [[Act.12.21|Act.12:21]] νόμος β., **a supreme law**, "a law which governs other laws and so has a specially regal character" (Hort), or because made by a king (_LAE_, p. 3673), [[Jas.2.8|Jas.2:8]] τις, **one in the service of a king, a courtier**, [[Jhn.4.46, 49|Jhn.4:46, 49]] (WH, mg., βασιλίσκος).†
(AS)

G0964.def:
**Βηθεσδά**, ἡ, indecl. (deriv. uncertain, see Westc. on [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]], and _DB_, i, 279),
**Bethesda**, **a pool in Jerusalem**: [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]], Rec. (Βηθζαθά, WH, Βηθσαϊδά, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G0977.def:
**βιβρώσκω**, poët, and late prose,
[in LXX for אכל ;]
**to eat**: [[Jhn.6.13|Jhn.6:13]]†
(AS)

G0902.def:
**βαΐον**, ου, τό
(also βὰϊον, another form of βὰϊς, from the Egyptian), [in LXX: [[1Ma.13.51|1Ma.13:51]] * ;] (frequently in Egyptian π., see MM, _Exp._, x)
**a palm-branch**: [[Jhn.12.13|Jhn.12:13]] (_DB_, i, 314).†
(AS)

G0923.def:
**Βαρσαββᾶς** (Rec. -αβᾶς), -ᾶ (Aram., **son of Sabba**),
**Barsabbas**:
1. **the surname of one Joseph**: [[Act.1.23|Act.1:23]]
2. **The surname of one Judas**: [[Act.15.22|Act.15:22]]
† (AS)

G0972.def:
**βίαιος**, -α, -ον
(βία), [in LXX for אָנַשׁ, עַז, צַר, etc. ;]
**violent**: [[Act.2.2|Act.2:2]]†
(AS)

G0939.def:
**βάσις**, ־εως, ἡ
(βαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for אֶדֶן ;]
1. **a step** (Æsch., al.).
2. Hence, **a foot** (Plat.; [[Wis.13.18|Wis.13:18]]): [[Act.3.7|Act.3:7]].
† (AS)

G0921.def:
**Βαρναβᾶς**, -α, ὁ (Aram. בַּר, **son**, as prefix to another word interpreted in [[Act.4.36|Act.4:36]], τῆς παρακλήσεως, perh. נְבוּאָה, wh., however, should be rendered by προφητεία as in II [[Est.6.14|Est.6:14]], LXX. Deiss., _BS_, 309f., thinks Β. may be a variant of the name Βαρνεβοῦς, **son of Nebo**, found in a Syrian Inscr., altered with a view to disguising its origin; see also Milligan, _NTD_, iii; Dalman, _Gr._, 142),
**Barnabas**: [[Act.4.36; 9.27; 11.22, 30; 12.25, 13-15|Act.4:36 9:27 11:22, 30 12:25 13-15]], [[1Co.9.6|1Co.9:6]], [[Gal.2.1, 9, 13|Gal.2:1, 9 13]], [[Col.4.10|Col.4:10]].†
(AS)

G0989.def:
**βλάσφημος**, -ον
(βλασ-, of uncertain deriv., see Thayer, Boisacq; + φήμη, speech), [in LXX: [[Isa.66.3|Isa.66:3]] (מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן), [[Wis.1.6|Wis.1:6]], [[Sir.3.16|Sir.3:16]], [[2Ma.9.28; 10.4, 36|2Ma.9:28 10:4, 36]] * ;]
(a) **evil-speaking, slanderous, blasphemous**: [[Act.6.11|Act.6:11]], [[2Ti.3.2|2Ti.3:2]], [[2Pe.2.11|2Pe.2:11]] (cf. [[Jude.9|Ju 9]]);
(b) as subst. **a blasphemer**: [[1Ti.1.13|1Ti.1:13]] (Cremer, 570).
† (AS)

G0959.def:
**Βερνίκη** (elsewhere Βερενίκη), Macedonian form of Φερενίκη, cf. _Veronica, Victoria_), -ης, ἡ,
**Bernice, Berenice**, dau. of Herod Agrippa I: [[Act.25.13, 23; 26.3|Act.25:13, 23 26:3]]o.†
(AS)

G0996.def:
**βοήθεια**, -ας, ἡ (see: βοηθέω),
[in LXX for עֵזֶר, etc. ;]
**help**: [[Heb.4.16|Heb.4:16]] pl., **helps, "frapping,"** a technical nautical term (MM, _Exp._, x; _DB_, _ext._, 367): [[Act.27.17|Act.27:17]]†
(AS)

G0915.def:
**βάρβαρος**, -ον (prob. onomatop., descriptive of unintelligible sounds),
[in LXX: [[Psa.114.1|Ps 113 (114):1]] (לעז), [[Ezk.21.31|Eze.21:31]] (36) (בּער), [[2Ma.2.21; 4.25; 10.4|2Ma.2:21 4:25 10:4]], [[3Ma.3.24|3Ma.3:24]] * ;]
**barbarous, barbarian**, **strange to Greek language and culture **(and also, after the Persian war, with the added sense of **brutal, rude**): [[Act.28.2|Act.28:2]], 4 [[Rom.1.14|Rom.1:14]], [[1Co.14.11|1Co.14:11]], [[Col.3.11|Col.3:11]] (see Lft., in l., and _Notes_, 249).†
(AS)

G0948.def:
**βδελύσσω**, **βδελύσσομαι**
(βδέω, **to stink**), [in LXX chiefly for שׁקץ ,תּעב ;]
in cl., mid. only (Attic, -ττομαι); **to make foul**; pass., [[Rev.21.8|Rev.21:8]] mid., **to turn away in disgust from, to detest**: [[Rom.2.22|Rom.2:22]] (Cremer, 137).†
(AS)

G0949.def:
**βέβαιος**, -ον (also -α, -ον; βαίνω),
[in LXX: [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]], [[Wis.7.23|Wis.7:23]], [[3Ma.5.31; 7.7|3Ma.5:31 7:7]], [[4Ma.17.4|4Ma.17:4]] * ;]
**firm, secure**: ἄγκυρα, [[Heb.6.19|Heb.6:19]] metaphorically, **sure** (esp. "in the sense of legally guaranteed security," Deiss., _BS_, 109; cf . two foll. words): ἐπαγγελία, [[Rom.4.16|Rom.4:16]] ἐλπίς, [[2Co.1.6|2Co.1:6]] λόγος, [[Heb.2.2|Heb.2:2]] παρρησία, [[Heb.3.6|Heb.3:6]] ἀρχή (τ. ὑποστάσεως), [[Heb.3.14|Heb.3:14]] διαθήκη, [[Heb.9.17|Heb.9:17]] κλῆσις κ. ἐκλογή, [[2Pe.1.10|2Pe.1:10]] comp. (-ότερος), προφητικὸς λόγος, [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]]†
(AS)

G0950.def:
**βεβαιόω**, -ῶ
(βέβαιος), [in LXX: Ps 40 (41)12 (נצב hi.), 118 (119)28 (קוּם pi.), [[3Ma.5.42|3Ma.5:42]] * ;]
**to confirm, establish, secure**, of things (cl.): λόγον, Mk 16:[20]; ἐπαγγελίας, [[Rom.15.8|Rom.15:8]] of persons (_DCG_, ii, 605): [[1Co.1.8|1Co.1:8]], [[2Co.1.21|2Co.1:21]]. Pass., [[1Co.1.6|1Co.1:6]], [[Col.2.7|Col.2:7]], [[Heb.2.3; 13.9|Heb.2:3 13:9]] (as an Attic legal term, **to guarantee** the validity of a purchase, **establish** or **confirm** a title; see next word, Cremer, 139; cf. δια-β.).†
(AS)

G0955.def:
**Βελίαλ**, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּלִיַּעַל, **worthlessness**, but see _DB_, i, 268),
**Belial**, a name of Satan: [[2Co.6.15|2Co.6:15]], Rec. See next word.†
**Βελιάρ**, ὁ, indecl. (another form of previous word, "due to harsh Syriac pronunciation," or else Heb. בֵּל יַעַר, _lord of the forest_),
**Beliar**, a name of Satan: [[2Co.6.15|2Co.6:15]] (see _DB_, i, 269).†
(AS)

G0940.def:
**βασκαίνω**,
[in LXX: [[Deu.28.54, 56|Deu.28:54, 56]] (רעע), [[Sir.14.6|Sir.14:6]], 8*.]
1. **to slander** (Dem.).
2. **to blight by the evil eye, to fascinate, bewitch**: [[Gal.3.1|Gal.3:1]]
† (AS)

G0956.def:
**βέλος**, -εος, τό
(βάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for חֵץ ;]
**a missile, a dart**: [[Eph.6.16|Eph.6:16]]†
(AS)

G0951.def:
**βεβαίωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(βεβαιόω, which see), [in LXX: [[Lev.25.23|Lev.25:23]] (צְמִיתֻת), [[Wis.6.19|Wis.6:19]] * ;]
**confirmation**: τ. εὐαγγελίου, [[Php.1.7|Php.1:7]] εἰς β., [[Heb.6.16|Heb.6:16]], a phrase frequently in π. of guarantee in a business transaction (Deiss., _BS_, 104ff.; Cremer, 140).†
(AS)

G0952.def:
**βέβηλος**, -ον
(βαίνω, whence βηλός, _a threshold_), [in LXX chiefly for חֹל ;]
1. **permitted to be trodden, accessible** (see _DCG_, ii, 422b); hence,
2. (opposite to ἱερός) **unhallowed, profane**: of things, [[1Ti.4.7; 6.20|1Ti.4:7 6:20]], [[2Ti.2.16|2Ti.2:16]]; of men, [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]], [[Heb.12.16|Heb.12:16]] (cf. κοινός; Cremer, 140).
† (AS)

G0957.def:
**βελτίων**, -ον (genitive -ονος), comp. of ἀγαθός,
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
neut. as _adv._, **better, very well**: [[2Ti.1.18|2Ti.1:18]] (also [[Act.10.28|Act.10:28]] D). On _elative_ use in these passages, see M, _Pr._, 78, 236.†
(AS)

G0998.def:
**βοηθός**, -ον (see: βοηθέω),
[in LXX chiefly for עזר ;]
1. (poët. -όος), **hasting to the war-cry** (Hom.).
2. **helping, auxiliary**; as subst. (Hdt.), **a helper**: [[Heb.13.6|Heb.13:6]] (LXX).
† (AS)

G0995.def:
**βοή**, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX for זְעָקָה, etc. ;]
**a cry**: [[Jas.5.4|Jas.5:4]]†
(AS)

G0934.def:
**βασίλειος**, -ον (also -α, -ον; βασιλεύς),
[in LXX; [[Exo.19.6|Exo.19:6]], [[Deu.3.10|Deu.3:10]] (מַמְלָכָה), [[Exo.23.22|Exo.23:22]], [[Wis.18.15|Wis.18:15]], [[3Ma.3.28|3Ma.3:28]], [[4Ma.3.8|4Ma.3:8]] * ;]
**royal**: [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX) (see Hort, in l.).†
**royal, regal, kingly;**, _metaphorically_ **possessed of high prerogatives and distinction,** [[1Pe.2.9|1Pet. 2:9]] (AS)

G0980.def:
**βιόω**, -ῶ
(βίος), [in LXX: [[Pro.7.2; 9.6|Pro.7:2 9:6]] (חיה), [[Job.29.18|Job.29:18]], [[Wis.4.4|Wis.4:4]] א 1, 12:23, [[Sir.40.28|Sir.40:28]], [[4Ma.5.22; 17.18|4Ma.5:22 17:18]] * ;]
**to spend life, to live**: τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), [[1Pe.4.2|1Pe.4:2]] (cf. Jb, l.with).†
_SYN._: ζάω (which see). (AS)

G0990.def:
**βλέμμα**, -τος, τό
(βλέπω),
**a look, a glance**: βλέμματι καὶ ἀκοῇ, [[2Pe.2.8|2Pe.2:8]], **sight and hearing**, a sense not found for β. in Gk. lit., but perh. recognized in the vernacular (**ICC**, in l.)†
(AS)

G0974.def:
**βιβλαρίδιον**, -ου, τό (diminutive of βιβλάριον, diminutive of βίβλος),
**a little book**: [[Rev.10.2|Rev.10:2]], 8 (WH, βιβλιόν, T2, 7 βιβλιδάριον) 9, 10. Not hitherto found elsewhere.†
(AS)

G0969.def:
**βήρυλλος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX: [[Tob.13.17|Tob.13:17]] (-ύλλιον in [[Exo.28.20|Exo.28:20]], שֹׁהַם * ;])
**beryl**, a jewel of sea-green colour: [[Rev.21.20|Rev.21:20]]†
(AS)
